ruleset.name: OC2R PMD Silent Failure Rules
ruleset.description: Rules against tests that can pass while hiding a failure. Applied to src/test and to the in-game test sources (src/main/java/li/cil/oc2/gametest).

rule.name: SilentCatchInTest
rule.message: A catch block in a test must rethrow, assert/fail, or record the exception; otherwise the failure is silently ignored
rule.description: A catch block whose body neither throws, nor calls an assert*/fail method, nor records the exception (a call to add or set, e.g. into a failure list or AtomicReference that the test asserts on later) lets a test keep going after an error. Intentional fallbacks need a NOPMD comment that says why.

rule.name: NoDisabledOrAssumedTests
rule.message: Tests must not be disabled or skipped through assumptions; fix or delete them
rule.description: @Disabled and Assumptions.assume* turn a failing or unrunnable test into a silent skip that still shows up green. Track broken tests in the roadmap instead.
